subject: Re: IPDF kickoff - staffing + June Vulcan booking
body:
Dmitri,

Resourcing:

- Staffing: Yara 40%, Katya 60%, Nikhil 50%, Leilani 40% through July 6.
- Day-to-day: training runs are single-GPU-friendly (batch 128 per the released SYMSOL config); 16 titan-a100 best-effort covers the repro matrix.
- The June booking: we hold the vulcan-h100 reservation - 256 accelerators for the week of 2026-06-15 - for the full evaluation sweep. The driver is evaluation, not training: resolving tightly-focused densities on SO(3) needs the dense rotation grid (2M+ query points per example), and doing that across the whole SYMSOL suite plus our internal parts set is a genuinely large batch job. Placement note: Vulcan's maintenance window is June 22-24, so our week lands us right before it - if we slip the sweep we lose three more days on top, which is why Leilani is doing a dry run at 1/10 scale the week prior.

No other asks. Budget fits the existing envelope.

Santiago
